content.title: Does Project Hail Mary have a post-credit scene?
content.text:
POP-CULTUREIs there a post-credit scene for 'Project Hail Mary'?Caroline DarneyFor The WinMarch 19, 2026, 7:49 a.m. ETKeep WatchingRyan Gosling returns to the big screen this week with the much anticipated Project Hail Mary releasing on March 20. Gosling takes on the beloved character Ryland Grace from Andy Weir's novel, a middle school teacher that wakes up in space on a mission to save the planet. He teams up with an unlikely friend as the duo attempts to problem solve their way back home, but things get complicated.Project Hail Mary, which was directed by the duo of Phil Lord and Christopher Miller (Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse), has received rave reviews so far from both critics and viewers, at 95 percent and 98 percent, respectively.With many fans headed to the theater this weekend for the heartwarming epic, should people stick around after the credits start to roll for any extra content?No, you're set to head out at the end of the movie with no extra mid-credit or post-credit scenes.Project Hail Mary will be in theaters nationwide on Friday.#1 Car Scratch Tool Easily Erases Any Scratches And Dents InstantlySave $300 on body shop repairs instantlyGekkoGifts | SponsoredSponsoredLearn MoreUndoTop U.S. Memory Loss Experts: Avoid This Drink Like It’s Poison.
